standard.note: Final step of SB 437 (2019). No escalator -- New Mexico has been flat since 2023.

tipped.note: N.M. Stat. 50-4-22. Santa Fe, Santa Fe County and Las Cruces set their own, different tipped rules -- see local/NM-local-2026.json.

knownGaps: Santa Fe (city and county) and Las Cruces exceed the state rate; Albuquerque and Bernalillo County have been overtaken by it except for their tipped rules -- see local/NM-local-2026.json.
